name: URTC-UPDATER
build: Detects local URTC projects, compares their manifests with GitHub and performs explicit install or update actions.
notes: Adapted from HYDRA-UMC-UPDATER's own proven design (the same atomic-by-verification staging-clone install/update, manifest discovery and evidence log), scoped to just the URTC ecosystem's own urtc.project.json/ecosystem: "URTC" repositories instead of HYDRA-UMC's. Every URTC repository is public, so remote discovery works with no GITHUB_TOKEN at all. Run for real, end to end, against GitHub in an isolated workspace: a clean install and a later update of a real repository both cloned, built (106 own tests passing), and promoted correctly, with the previous checkout kept as an atomic backup.
